projects.name: 8-Relay Switch Bank
projects.summary: 8-relay, 8-input boat switch bank over Signal K and NMEA 2000
projects.description: Firmware for the Waveshare ESP32-S3-ETH-8DI-8RO-C industrial relay board: 8 relays you can switch and 8 isolated inputs you can read, over Signal K (WiFi or Ethernet) and NMEA 2000 (PGN 127502/127501) at the same time. Per relay: name, latching or momentary with auto-off, and a chosen behaviour on Signal K loss or restart. Time-based schedules kept on the board's own real-time clock.

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-ETH-8DI-8RO-C
boards.notes: 8 MB octal PSRAM (ESP32-S3R8), 16 MB flash, W5500 Ethernet plus WiFi fallback, isolated CAN transceiver for NMEA 2000.

projects.name: BLE Gateway
projects.summary: Bridges Bluetooth sensors into Signal K
projects.description:
Scans for Bluetooth Low Energy sensors — temperature, humidity, battery monitors — and forwards their readings to a Signal K server.

Runs on the Waveshare ESP32-P4 boards (BLE via their ESP32-C6 co-processor, which is what two gateways here use in daily service; the PoE-ETH on its cable, the Touch-LCD boards on WiFi) and on the ESP32, C3, S3 and C6.

Not the ESP32-C5: it builds and scans, then reboots after about 30 seconds. BLE plus WiFi plus the Signal K client needs ~152 KB of its ~176 KB of internal RAM, the HTTP posts start failing and the health watchdog restarts the board. Its 8 MB of PSRAM does not help — what remains is task stacks and DMA buffers, which cannot live in external RAM. A C5 is a good WiFi/Signal K board, but it is not a BLE bridge.

boards.name: ESP32-C6 development board
boards.notes: The ESP32-C6-MINI-1U has no PCB antenna: without an external one the radio sees nothing, which looks exactly like a software fault.

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-P4: POE-ETH, Touch-LCD-7B or Touch-LCD-X
boards.notes: One image for all three boards: the PoE-ETH runs on its cable, the Touch-LCD boards on WiFi with the screen left dark. Releases up to 1.0.0 have WiFi off and only work on the PoE-ETH. On the PoE-ETH, never connect USB and Ethernet at the same time: powering the board from USB and PoE together damages it.

projects.name: P4 Cockpit
projects.summary: Touch instrument panel for Signal K, on a Waveshare ESP32-P4 display
projects.description: A configurable instrument panel: gauges, arcs, anchor watch and digital switching, laid out in the Signal K HMI designer and rendered on the panel. Also does voice control and NMEA 2000 over CAN.

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-7B (1024x600)
boards.notes: 1024x600 landscape, EK79007 controller. The 7B and the X are different boards: the wrong firmware leaves the screen black, because each drives a backlight pin the other does not connect.

boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-X, 7 inch (720x1280, rotated)
boards.notes: 720x1280 portrait ILI9881C on a 7-inch panel, shown rotated to landscape by the P4 PPA. Each size in the X series uses a different display controller, so a build is specific to one: the 8-inch and 10.1-inch X panels are JD9365 and are not supported. Not interchangeable with the 7B either — see that board's note.
